input.command:
python3 -c '
# Pose at obs 88:
# obs 87 pose: X = -1.1348, Y = 5.0972, theta = 300 deg
# turn -90 -> theta = 210 deg
# move 0.5 along 210 deg:
# X = -1.1348 + 0.5 * sin(210 deg) = -1.1348 - 0.2500 = -1.3848
# Y = 5.0972 + 0.5 * cos(210 deg) = 5.0972 - 0.4330 = 4.6642

# In obs 88:
# We are looking south-southwest (heading 210 deg).
# Chair 2 is in the foreground right, Chair 1 is straight ahead in the center!
import cv2, numpy as np
img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0088.png")

# Measure Chair 1 (center chair):
# Chair 1 is around x in [170, 260], y in [260, 390]
mask = (img[:,:,2] > 90) & (img[:,:,2] < 160) & (img[:,:,1] > 40) & (img[:,:,1] < 80) & (img[:,:,0] < 40)
ys1, xs1 = np.where(mask[:, 170:260])
xs1 += 170
print(f"Chair 1 in obs 88: x=[{xs1.min()}, {xs1.max()}], y=[{ys1.min()}, {ys1.max()}], bottom_y={ys1.max()}, center_x={xs1.mean():.1f}")
'
